Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.identifier.generate
role Generate optional-prefixed, sortable, URL-safe identifiers for RelayDock records and leases.
owns identifier wire format, timestamp ordering prefix, random collision suffix
invariant The encoded identifier contains no padding and remains safe in URLs and filenames. A requested prefix is preserved before one underscore without changing the sortable timestamp portion.
effect clock.read, random.read
risk availability
